exposure: cessation of intravenous oxytocin at 15 minutes post birth
cessation of intravenous oxytocin at 30 minutes post birth
cessation of intravenous oxytocin at 60 minutes post birth
cohort: Women who had an induced spontaneous vaginal birth and received intrapartum intravenous oxytocin at an Australian tertiary obstetric hospital.
finding: There was no statistically significant difference in the incidence of postpartum haemorrhage between women whose intravenous oxytocin was ceased 15, 30, or 60 minutes post birth.
